# inventory: mac: extend database and manage Launchpad by it

Grow [toolset/Inventory.yaml](../../toolset/Inventory.yaml) from a catalogue into the model that drives machine setup. **Motivation:** configuring an existing Mac still involves manual work. The inconveniences listed:

- **several versions of one app** — 1Password 7 (App Store) and 8 (cask) are one product split into two records (lines 3–14 at the time, [[DOT-325]]);
- **iOS apps** have no place in the model;
- **per-device selection** — everything is installed everywhere, while the author wants "profiles";
- **Launchpad layout** is lost on every reinstall and rebuilt by hand. Launchpad's state is a SQLite database at `$(getconf DARWIN_USER_DIR)com.apple.dock.launchpad/db/db`; the note gives the queries for folders (`items` ⋈ `groups`) and apps (`items` ⋈ `apps`) and proposes declaring the Launchpad sections in the inventory and writing a migration that groups items accordingly.
